# pve_acl (Data Source)

Retrieves the full access control list (`GET /access/acl`). The server restricts the result to entries the caller has permission to modify.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_acl" "all" {}

output "acl_entries" {
  value = data.pve_acl.all.entries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Every visible ACL entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Static identifier for the ACL list.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Access control path the entry applies to.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Whether the permission propagates to child paths. Defaults to `true` when the server omits the flag.
- `role` (String) Role name granted on `path`.
- `type` (String) Kind of subject. One of: `user`, `group`, `token`.
- `ugid` (String) User or group ID (for tokens, the full token ID such as `user@realm!tokenname`).
